newsitem.title: FRANCE: Southern Airlines to handle some Prime clients.
newsitem.headline: Southern Airlines to handle some Prime clients.

text.p: Prime Air Services said it had appointed fellow French cargo sales agent, Southern Airlines Services, to handle cargo for four of its airline customers in provincial France, effective October 1.
"Southern will represent L.T.U., Challenge Air Cargo, Air Namibia and Air Alfa on our behalf from Nice, Marseille, Lyon , Toulouse and Boreaux," a Prime official told Reuters.
Previously, Prime delegated Paris-based staff to develop traffic in provincial France, the official said.
"Having on-the-spot representation will mean a better coverage of these markets."
Southern will organise the transport of shipments from the provinces to Prime's base at CDG for consolidation and trucking to European gateways.
Three of the four airlines in question are off-line in France with L.T.U. operating from Dusseldorf, Air Namibia from Frankfurt and Turkish carrier, Air Alfa, from Amsterdam, the official added.
Challenge Air books capacity on Air France scheduled freighter services from Paris to Miami.
Prime also represents Air UK and Ghana Airways in France while Southern is general sales agent for DAS Cargo, British Airways Plc at Nice and Trans World Airlines Inc at Marseille.
